namespace Geometry.Modern;

public class Primary(IShapeService service, ILogger<Primary> logger) : Base(service), IPrimary
{
    public required int Id { get; init; }
    public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    public Owner? Maybe => null;
    public List<Owner> Owners { get; } = [];
    public field_like Weird { get; set; }
    public int Computed { get { return Helper.Value(); } }
    public Owner Expr => new Owner("a", null, null);
    public void Use() { service.Validate(); logger.LogInformation("x"); }
    public static int operator +(Primary a, int b) => b;
    public ref int RefReturn(ref int x) => ref x;
    public (int A, string B) Tuple() => (1, "b");
    public int[] Array() => [];
    public Owner[]? Arrays() => null;
    public Geometry.Core.Owner Qualified() => null;
    public System.Text.StringBuilder Builder() => new();
    protected internal virtual void Both() { }
    private protected abstract sealed override void Weird2() { }
    file class FileLocal { }
}

public class Base(IShapeService s)
{
    public Base() : this(null) { }
}
